title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：patient　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 patient 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the nurse ① saw the patient that no sufferer in the ward would have noted, and he said the seeing was the whole of the night. The ② patient, meaning the sufferer itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a patient, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ patient in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ patient at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A patient, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the nurse said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the patient was the whole of the matter, meaning the trust and not the sufferer. The ⑥ patient, meaning the trust and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; patient, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both a sufferer and a trust. He said the trust is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ patient had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ patient of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of noting; patient, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ patient I remember is the sufferer noted in the report, which closed in 2000 and is still noted as the quietest in the ward. A ⑩ patient, my mother said in 2002, is the only sufferer that improves by being noted; every patient, she said, is a trust that has agreed to look like a sufferer. She said the trust was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 病人；患者（指病房里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 病人；患者（指那位病人本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the patient 诊视这一位病人
D. n. 病人；患者（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. 病人之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的病人之事）
F. n. 病人；患者（指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一位）
G. n. 病人、信赖（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信赖（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the patient that no sufferer in the ward would have noted
The patient, meaning the sufferer itself and not the thermometer
the patient at the far cupboard
the patient was the whole of the matter
the patient had become a line in a report
The patient of the whole thing
A patient, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: see the patient 意为“诊视这一位病人”，1993 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记下的一位病人做了一遍。
patient 意为“病人；患者”，指那位病人本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
patient 意为“病人；患者”，指病房里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
patient 意为“病人；患者”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
patient 意为“病人、信赖”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位信赖就是那件事的全部。
patient 意为“信赖”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位病人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
patient 意为“病人；患者”，指护理记录里写到、被记下的那一位，到 1998 年这一位成了护理记录里的一行。
patient 意为“病人之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的病人之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记下。
patient 意为“病人；患者”，我记得的是护理记录里记下过的那一位，2000 年挺过了，至今仍被说成病房里最安静的一位。
patient 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，病人是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的病人。
